scope.statement: The ritual pack uses a bounded account from the reviewed Deshpande English expression of Padma Purana, Uttara Khanda chapter 51. A future scripture/story owner should provide the lawful full expression, Sanskrit and edition coordinates, and reception context while preserving Bhima's stated inability to bear hunger, family pressure, Vyasa's waterless prescription, Dwadashi actions, threats, caste-denigrating language and promised results as source facts rather than universal fasting instructions, coercion or guarantees. Pandava Dwadashi remains source context unless material evidence establishes a distinct lane.
